layout.tagline: Official funding organ of the Republic. Installed at the Faculty of Mathematics and Statistics.

loggedOut.title: The machine of chance
loggedOut.body1: ATZAR — from the Catalan atzar, the chance the State administers on your behalf — is the Republic's official funding mechanism. A physical machine, installed at the Faculty of Mathematics and Statistics, where every identified citizen is entitled to one roll a day.
loggedOut.body2: The score is decided on the machine itself, never on this portal. Here we only record what the machine reports. Identify yourself to link your plays to your file.

lore.title: How it works
lore.body: Every identified citizen receives one free daily roll on the ATZAR machine, physically installed at the Faculty of Mathematics and Statistics. Press play on the device and it will show a code; enter that code here to link the play to your file. The score is computed there, not on this website. The portal only shows the history the machine chooses to report.

link.title: Link the machine
link.hint: Press play on the ATZAR machine and enter the code it shows. Each code is good for one play.

online.body: While the physical machine is being built, the Republic lets you roll from here. Same daily roll, same purchased rolls.
